text: Shows the forgot-password request flow, with the identical generic response for unknown emails and over-limit requests, and no email or link for either.
Shows the limit of 3 reset emails per account per rolling hour.
Shows that the token is 32 random bytes, carried only in the link, and stored only as a SHA-256 hash.
Shows the 30-minute expiry, single use, and that issuing a new link kills earlier unused links for the account.
Shows the token checked both when the page loads and when the form is submitted, with the 'link has expired, request a new one' page for invalid, expired or used tokens.
Shows the password rules (at least 12 characters, not on the breached list) and that a rejected password leaves the link usable.
Shows a successful reset: new hash stored, link burned, all sessions revoked including the current device, 'password changed' email sent, and a redirect to login with no automatic sign-in.
Shows email sent through the existing queue and worker, which retries up to 3 times with backoff and then logs and drops the job.
